title: the proxy's migration tooth reads the same on every box
intention: the proxy's migration tooth (old cache table gone, answers carried into the tree, meter carried into the log) reads the same on every box that runs it.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: live_the_table_is_gone_and_the_meter_carried (98ab0e9db57f tooth 7) reds '17 leaves in the answer tree' against its floor of 11366, and no dump of the old table stands under ~/.cairn/devices/inference_domain/0/temp; the migration ran on another box's database.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box); a device stands on one box.
how: Per open-39f6229e7241: (a) one box's tree: the tooth asks inference_domain on its home box over the bus for the leaf count and dump sums; (b) each box's own: the tooth judges a measured record of the migration (11366 leaves, the dump's spent/avoided sums) and asserts this box's tree is owned and its meter agrees with its own dump where one stands.

clauses.claim: tooth 7 reds when the carried counts or sums disagree

decisions.text: D1: tooth 7 reads the same on every box, by the branch open-39f6229e7241 names.

measured.saw: AssertionError: 17 leaves in the answer tree
measured.how: bin/cairn test over the proxy proof on akienasus
